sloka: भ्रातुः स भवनं गच्छन् रक्षोगणसमन्वितः ।कुम्भकर्णः पदन्यासैरकम्पयत मेदिनीम् ।। ६.६०.९५ ।।।।
transliteration: bhrātuḥ sa bhavanaṁ gacchan rakṣogaṇasamanvitaḥ ।kumbhakarṇaḥ padanyāsairakampayata medinīm ।। 6.60.95 ।।।।

translations.english: And then the Vanaras and the leaders of the Vanara army who were present looked at the immeasurably tall form of Kumbhakarna walking through the royal path and got alarmed.
